fato_historico: 1970: Black Tot Day: The last day of the officially sanctioned rum ration in the Royal Navy.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle transition, much like the final pouring of a storied tradition into the sea. Consider setting aside old rigid habits to make space for fluid, fresh perspectives. It is a good time to reflect on what sustains your spirit and what you are finally ready to release for personal growth.
frase_do_dia: True freedom begins when we let go of what no longer serves us.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the beginning of change.
conselho: Trust your intuition and allow yourself to flow with life's changing tides today.
